annotations.title: Agent stablecoin payments, over a window

description: Stablecoin transfers on x402 rails over a window you choose (default the last 24 hours), from how many paying addresses to how many receiving ones, by token and network, in four DISJOINT evidence classes: confirmed (the protocol’s own settlement event or payload), inferred (an identified x402 facilitator), candidate (only a shape x402 requires: a Solana memo beside a transfer into a listed seller, or a transfer to a catalogued payTo; compatible with x402, not proof) and unclassified; total = their sum. The strict figure is `confirmedPayments`; `payments` includes the candidates. Filter by stablecoin (USDC) or network. Free. No class shows what was bought, that it was delivered, or that an AI paid.
name: stablecoin_payments

byEvidence.description: Per network and evidence value (memo, facilitator, catalogued_payee, permit2-proxy, payload): payments, what it means, its evidenceClass and evidenceLevel, and every signal the classifier tested (signals, notProof). Null where the stored window predates the split.

byTokenAndNetwork.description: Per token and network: payments, payers, payees, amount.

confirmedPayments.description: The strict figure: transfers carrying the x402 protocol’s own settlement trace (evidenceClasses.confirmed). Null where the split is not known for this selection (e.g. a token filter on a stored window), never zero.

coverage.description: What is counted, matching the filter: the classes included and what is left out.

evidenceClasses.description: known, total, confirmed, inferred, candidate, unclassified (disjoint; total = sum; null where not known), reconciled, bySignal (per evidence value: class, level, label, payments), levels (1 compatible shape … 5 evidenced delivery), attributedRequests and evidencedDeliveries (always null: no on-chain reader reaches them), means, provenance.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

payments.description: Every counted transfer, candidates included: confirmed + inferred + candidate + unclassified. Not the strict figure (that is confirmedPayments); kept under this name for compatibility.

says.description: The answer, the confirmed figure first and candidates apart.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Agent stablecoin payments, over a window
